$comment: Reviewed Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon (add-privacy-preserving-analytics D4b: Cloudflare-hosted, SRI-pinned, until Cloudflare answers the self-hosting question, task 3.2). The build emits this exact integrity; browsers refuse any other bytes. Bump only after the review procedure in README.md. A weekly drift check (.github/workflows/beacon-drift.yml) compares the live file with this hash.
reviewedBy: Claude (agent, security-reviewer procedure); human security-reviewer sign-off pending (add-privacy-preserving-analytics 6.1)
reviewNotes: 2026.10.1 review (OpenSpec change patch-vitest-openspec-cli-and-beacon, design D3): diffed against the exact 2026.10.0 bytes (Wayback capture 20261001000800id_, gunzipped, SHA-384 equal to the previous pin), both pretty-printed with prettier 3.6.2; 103 changed lines. Changes: LCP attribution requires the matching resource entry to start before the LCP entry; the UA parser's WebKit branch matches AppleWebKit/ alone and falls back to an iOS version regex over navigator.userAgent (same data source); the Navigation API hook returns early for same-document navigations to the current URL (one new window.location.href read) and is still installed only when spa is not false, which we set; version strings 2026.10.1; one statement reordered. Unchanged: no innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/document.write/eval/new Function/WebAssembly/string timers; no cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB or Cache access; no createElement/setAttribute; only network destination https://cloudflareinsights.com/cdn-cgi/rum (sendBeacon / XHR); same navigator, performance, referrer and location reads; __cfBeacon precedence as reviewed 2026-10-08. No new page data is read, so /privacy and /cookies are unchanged. Prior review (2026.10.0, 2026-10-08): webpack wrapper replaced by a flat bundle, guarded polyfills, UA parser reads CriOS/FxiOS and derives OS versions from navigator.userAgent, __cfBeacon overrides data-cf-beacon (inert under our CSP).
